services.desc: The Gibson Room currently operates on a first come, first serve basis. We do not accept reservations. Think of us as your neighborhood bar - just come in and we’ll take care of you. blurb: We are a neighborhood bar on Coral Way, rooted in great food, sophisticated drinks, and a sense of community. Our kitchen features elevated bar food, including classics from Miami Slice, our 1/2 pound burger, and longtime Gibson Room favorites like the signature flan.
